title: Managed Backup: primary quantity
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines primary quantity.

## Tier basis

**Primary protected gb-month unit.** Primary meter quantity unit; string.

**Included primary quantity.** Primary meter quantity included per holding per complete month, prorated by active seconds; decimal.

**Minimum primary quantity.** Minimum primary quantity billed per measured resource interval; decimal.

**Primary meter increment.** Smallest billable primary meter increment in primary protected GB-month unit; positive decimal.

| Contract tier | Primary protected gb-month unit | Included primary quantity | Minimum primary quantity | Primary meter increment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | Protected GB-month | 0 | 0 | 0.000001 (1e-06) |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | Protected GB-month | 0 | 0 | 0.000001 (1e-06) |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | Protected GB-month | 0 | 0 | 0.000001 (1e-06) |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | Protected GB-month | 0 | 0 | 0.000001 (1e-06) |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | Protected GB-month | 0 | 0 | 0.000001 (1e-06) |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | Protected GB-month | 0 | 0 | 0.000001 (1e-06) |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, primary protected GB-month unit is Protected GB-month.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, primary protected GB-month unit stays the same.
